attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group (neither existed), set ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, and applied 750/640 permissions recursively (owner rwx, group r, others none) while preserving all existing file contents. Verified functionally that a group member can read the data and an unrelated user cannot. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, triggered a background-delayed reboot so the ack returned first, polled through the outage, confirmed a new boot_id post-restart, and re-verified ownership/permissions/content hashes were unchanged after recovery.
